text_block_list.text:
I hear excited cheers coming from the
distance.
When I get closer, I spot the
performers of the
celebration concert
rehearsing on an outdoor
stage.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: All righty! Let's do this!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
You're up next, McQueen! Match Spe's
pose and
start the choreography from
there!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: What?! This is far too sudden!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
You won't get anywhere thinking like
that! It has
to be sudden or you'll never
learn to improvise!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
This is a little late, but, um... do we
really need
improvisation training?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Of course! You gotta mentally prepare
too! I
mean, you'll probably end up
doing something
impromptu during the
breaks or even mid-song.
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Hm... That is logical.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
You heard her, McQueen! And you
better keep
your cool on the big night!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Excuse me?! You're the last person to be educating me on composure!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
You have to think on your feet to
improvise well.
It's about immediately
reacting to whatever
someone said or
did last.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
So when Спешл Уик says "Go get
'em!" and
does her dance, I could say...
"or go home."
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Exactly. It's practice to hone our
reflexes, so the
key is to keep going,
even if things go off the
rails! Okay, let's
try this again!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: All right, Hayahide! Your turn!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: I'm just getting started!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
D-don't get confused! This was just
meant to be
an "Ouch, my neck!" pose.
My head isn't actually
heavy!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Smile, Taishin! Smile!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Tch... I'm nowhere near done yet.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Behold! The Golshi legendary technique
is
a-coming!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: I'm lettin' loose and... takin' a break!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: ...That was more... ordinary than I was anticipating.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Hey! Y'all look like I goofed! But what I
really did
was throw you off to subvert
your expectations!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Darn it all... Suzuka, it's up to you now!
Pick up
what I'm puttin' down!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh! Um... uh...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Str...strawberry cake!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Well... when I hear "take a break," I
think of cake.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Ahaha! You've gotta link the dance move, not come up with some lame line! This isn't comedy improv! Hahaha!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Amazing! You did it, Suzuka! Your
awkwardness
was super adorable! Full
marks!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Heh... Hehehe! Thank you, Ticket.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Today's practice was such a great time! I
laughed
so hard!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, me too. Everyone's ideas came
together to
form a dance no one
could've expected.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The concert is going to be
absolutely
amazing! I just know it!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! With our crew, it'll definitely be a

performance full of surprises, that's for
sure!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Could that be... why I'm so excited?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
